name: ea-polluter
title: ea-polluter
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test-only polluter driver for T15e driver 1 (slice resources-enemies): generates the chunks round a site, places fuelled stone furnaces there and adds pollution at the site on a fixed period, so the nests round it absorb it and send attacks, then writes script-output/ea-polluter/<label>.json with the spawners, worms and units round the site and the units that reached it; the runner times the window with --benchmark-verbose all (pathFinder per tick). Configured by startup settings the runner writes; it gets every position from the runner at run time. Never shipped.
